refundContent.intro: All pass requests are subject to confirmation by the event organizers.
refundContent.cancellation: If you need to cancel a confirmed request, please contact our team as soon as possible using the contact details provided on this website.
refundContent.refund: Any refund, where applicable, will be processed according to the cancellation terms communicated by the event organizers at the time of confirmation.
refundContent.contact: For cancellation or refund-related questions, please contact our team directly.
